products.broker_conditions: Any MT5 broker offering BTCUSD; developed on Exness-style pricing (raw spread + commission)
products.intended_use: Rule-based trading on BTCUSD; start on a demo account
products.description: Enters on a Supertrend flip: a stop entry at the break of the flip candle's high (BUY) or low (SELL), cancelled if the trend flips back first. Exits when a candle closes through the EMA 9 against the trade and price breaks that candle (only once the trade is beyond entry), on a Supertrend flip against the trade, or at the stop loss. ADX filter keeps it out of dead and over-extended markets. Every rule is fixed in code - no emotions, no revenge trades, no hesitation.
products.risk: No verified backtest, out-of-sample or demo results are published yet - they will be added here after validation. BTCUSD on M1 is very volatile; spread, commission and slippage can make results much worse than any replay. Use a small risk (1% or less per trade) and a demo account first.

versions.notes: Raw Digital Works editions (Free / Standard / Unlimited). Supertrend flip entry, EMA 9 breakout exit, Supertrend flip exit.

products.name: RDW Supertrend EA - Free
products.summary: Try the full strategy free: Supertrend flip entries and disciplined exits on BTCUSD, with safe settings locked in.
includes: Fixed SL $300 / Target $500 and ADX 20-30 filter
how_to_use: Install in MetaTrader 5: File → Open Data Folder → MQL5 → Experts.
Attach to a BTCUSD M1 chart and enable Algo Trading.
Settings are locked in the Free edition - just watch it follow the rules.
Run on a demo account first.
